About Mondan

One firm for the study, the design and the build

Mondan Limited is an Environmental Services, Research and Construction consulting firm registered in Ghana under the Companies Act, 1963 (Act 179). Our main office is at Awukugwa-Akuapem, close to the SDA school.

We offer holistic environmental solutions to private businesses and governmental organisations, locally and internationally. The firm also builds: roads, residential and commercial buildings, water supply systems, and drainage and sanitation systems.

Vision

To be the model firm for the environmental services, research and construction industry, through high-quality, excellent services to clients locally and internationally.

Mission

To proffer innovative solutions and strategies to global environmental services, research and construction challenges faced by governments, businesses and international organisations, at a satisfactory and cost-effective level.

Offices

Main office at Awukugwa-Akuapem near SDA School, Eastern Region. Sub-offices at Pantang in Greater Accra and at Kyekyewere in Obuasi.

Scope of service

What we do for our clients

Waste and sanitation

Solid and liquid waste management for businesses and governments.

  • Plastic waste and e-waste management
  • Wastewater management and waste processing schemes
  • Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) schemes
  • Policies, guidelines and master plans

Studies and assessments

Technical field studies, feasibility work and environmental monitoring.

  • ESIA, SEA, ESMF and ESMP studies
  • Sanitation and waste management studies
  • Environmental monitoring and auditing
  • Drainage studies and socio-economic surveys
  • Effluent, wastewater and leachate analysis

Design, build and manage

From planning and contract documents to construction and supervision.

  • Feasibility studies and project design
  • Water supply systems with submersible pumps and distribution networks
  • Pre and post-contract services and tender evaluation
  • Contract supervision
  • Project management for short, medium and long-term assignments

Fields of operation

Across civil and environmental engineering, gender and development, agriculture and poverty reduction, water resources, development planning and education.

Solid and liquid waste management Policy and guidelines development Environmental and social risk assessment Water supply design and construction Water resources development Construction, supervision and management Drainage and building design Occupational health and safety Natural resources management Capacity building and training Gender-based research Sustainability and community development Remote sensing and GIS Agriculture Climate change
Consulting standards

Work that meets international standards

Every consulting activity at Mondan must meet international standards, including the IFC Performance Standards on Environmental and Social Sustainability, the World Bank Operational Manual (OP 4), the ISO 9000 series, and other international conventions and protocols on environmental sustainability.

External auditors
PURE 2A and Associates, for mandatory audits and compliance with tax laws and Ghana Revenue Authority regulations.
Bankers
United Bank for Africa (UBA)
Equipment and software

Equipped for the office and the field

Indoors, our staff work with printers, photocopiers, binding machines and personal computers. Outdoors, they use remote sensing and GIS instruments, cameras, a 4x4 vehicle, a saloon car and construction equipment. Other equipment is rented or hired for specific services when required.

Geotechnical

  • C-"Bear": bearing capacity of shallow foundations
  • ArcGIS

Statistical

  • STATA
  • SPSS
  • R
  • Excel

Water resources engineering

  • "DRIP": drainage design in pavements
  • SMADA 1."0": storm water management and design
  • "Hy22": drainage of highway pavements
  • "MOUSE": urban basin and sewerage
  • GMS and Aquifer Test
